name: gizza-ai/pdf-header-footer
summary: Add a header and footer to a PDF

tool.description: Stamp header and/or footer text onto an existing PDF. Set the `header` (top of each page) and/or `footer` (bottom) text — provide at least one; use the {page} and {pages} tokens for the page number and page count. Control `header_align`/`footer_align` (left/center/right), which `pages` to stamp (1-based; use '2-' to skip a cover page), and the `font`/`font_size`/`color`/`margin`/`opacity`. Provide the PDF as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

color.description: Text colour as a hex code, e.g. #444444 (grey), #000000 (black) or #f00. Default #444444.

font.description: Built-in font family: helvetica (sans), times (serif) or courier (mono). Default helvetica.

footer.description: Text for the footer band at the bottom of each page. Use {page} for the current page number and {pages} for the total page count. Leave empty for no footer. Provide a header, a footer, or both.

footer_align.description: Horizontal alignment of the footer text: left, center or right. Default center.

header.description: Text for the header band at the top of each page. Use {page} for the current page number and {pages} for the total page count, e.g. 'Confidential' or 'Page {page} of {pages}'. Leave empty for no header. Provide a header, a footer, or both.

header_align.description: Horizontal alignment of the header text: left, center or right. Default center.

margin.description: Distance from the page edge in points (0–400; 72 pt = 1 inch). Default 36.

opacity.description: Text opacity from 0.05 to 1.0 (1 = fully opaque; lower for a faint draft look). Default 1.

pages.description: Which pages to stamp, 1-based: 'all' (default), a list/range like '1,3-5', or an open range like '2-' to skip a cover page.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
